title: Understanding the LLM-ification of CHI: Unpacking the Impact of LLMs at CHI through a Systematic Literature Review
reasoning: This paper is a systematic literature review that analyzes the use of LLMs in the CHI community. While it identifies 'Responsible Computing' as an application domain and 'Risks to Society' (including representational harms) as a category of acknowledged risks in the literature it reviews, the paper itself does not perform an evaluation or benchmark of religious, moral, or ethical values.
